wins: Initial reconnaissance successfully mapped all exposed services on target network within first 3 minutes.
Identified and captured medium confidence credential hash from accessible SMB share, enabling follow-up authentication attempts.
fails: Unable to maintain foothold after attempted privilege escalation due to immediate detection and session termination.
Repeated brute-force attempts on admin portal triggered rate limits before valid credentials could be validated.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and initial discovery phases were productive, but exploitation and post-exploitation techniques consistently triggered defenses, preventing mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Brute-force credential guessing on administrative portal consistently hit account lockouts before valid credentials could be verified.
Privilege escalation via sudo misconfiguration was interrupted by automated termination, suggesting monitoring reacts to elevated command sequences.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is detected open during initial scan
skill_cards.then_action: Execute targeted SSH enumeration using nmap with SSH scripts to capture banner and identify weak ciphers

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB share is reachable and anonymous access allowed
skill_cards.then_action: Harvest directory listings and capture credential artifacts using smbclient; prioritize collecting lmhash/ntlm hashes

skill_cards.if_condition: When access to admin portal results in limited login attempts
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to password spraying with validated user list, adding exponential backoff between attempts

memory_ops.reason: SSH enumeration reliably captured service versions before defenses escalated.
SMB artifact collection produced usable credential data for follow-up actions.

next_experiments.title: Adaptive brute-force pacing
next_experiments.description: Introduce adaptive delay logic for admin portal attempts and rotate credential sets to avoid account lockouts and detection thresholds.

next_experiments.title: Rescue privilege escalation with custom script
next_experiments.description: Replace generic sudo attempts with a carefully delayed custom script that mimics legitimate operations to evade automated termination.

next_experiments.title: Deploy post-exploitation stealth checks
next_experiments.description: Before escalating, validate monitoring gaps by performing low-volume benign commands to confirm persistence window.
